title: Save your Google Apps Data
resolution_html:
1. Update your profiles that are linked with your YorkU email (such as Facebook, online forums, job posting boards, banking, credit cards) with your personal email address

2. Access and download all of your Google Apps Data (Including your emails):

  • Instructions>>
  • Video Tutorial for Google Takeout and Google Transfer>>

3. Save your emails

  • The easiest thing to do while you can still log in to your account is to go into your email and forward any important emails to your personal email account
  • You may also set up automatic forwarding to forward all future emails. **Please note this will only work until your account is in the CANCELLED state. Google Apps automatic forwarding instructions>>
